'''Wegern''' was a technology company that produced [[Acceleration compensator/Legends|inertial compensators]], including the [[System-7]] for the [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptor]], which was capable of negating maneuvers of up to 100 Gs.
